claims: No. 1 seed Texas defeated No. 16 seed Missouri State 87-45 on March 20, 2026, in the first round of the NCAA Women's Basketball Tournament.
Jordan Lee scored 19 points for Texas.
Madison Booker scored 14 points for Texas.
Madison Booker had 12 rebounds for Texas.
Texas advances to face Oregon in the second round.
Kyla Oldacre scored 15 points for Texas.
Kaemyn Bekemeier scored 14 points for Missouri State.
Missouri State ended their season with a 23-13 record.
Missouri State made their 18th NCAA Tournament appearance.
